authentication.other: API Key + Secret query/body params, or JWT signed by private key

evidence.title: Vonage API Authentication Guide
evidence.excerpt: Vonage APIs support two main authentication mechanisms: API Key/Secret for legacy APIs, and Application IDs with JSON Web Tokens (JWT) signed by a private key for modern APIs.
